description: Main Flutter application source file setting up environment, theme, main app widget, routing, and persistent storage for a Todo app.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: Data model class representing a single Todo with properties for id, title, details, completion status, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: TodoDatabaseHelper
classes.description: Singleton class managing SQLite database creation and CRUD operations for Todo items.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier, managing list of Todo items with methods for adding, updating, deleting, and refreshing from database.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Root stateless widget setting up MaterialApp and theme for the todo application.

classes.name: TodoHomeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget serving as the main screen displaying active/completed todos, with add/edit and delete functionalities.

classes.name: TodoCard
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying a single todo item with checkbox, tap to edit, and swipe-to-delete features.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the app, initializes Flutter bindings, environment, system orientation, clean database setup, and runs the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets like TodoApp, TodoHomeScreen, and TodoCard, defining UI structure and user interactions.

methods.name: _showAddOrEditTodo
methods.description: Displays modal bottom sheet for adding or editing a todo, handles input validation and calls provider methods.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of a TodoItem with optional new values for its properties.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts a TodoItem into a Map for database insertion or update.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a TodoItem from a Map retrieved from the database.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes database connection and creates the table if necessary.

methods.name: getAllTodos
methods.description: Fetches all todos from the database ordered by creation date.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Inserts a new Todo item into the database.

methods.name: updateTodo
methods.description: Updates an existing Todo item in the database.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Deletes a Todo item from the database by id.

methods.name: refreshTodos
methods.description: Refreshes local list of todos from the database and notifies listeners.
